name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-10-27, at wavelengths from 1.69 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
